subject: Re: CPPO onboarding — invoice routing and split billing for CloudWave
messages:
From: Alex Kim <alex@cloudwave.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CPPO: billing flow & split invoicing question

Hi Tessa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to move forward with the AWS Channel Private Offer (CPPO) for the 250k commit, but we have a couple of billing questions before we sign:

- CloudWave needs the commitment to appear on our AWS invoice, but the pass-through invoicing must be split between CloudWave (70%) and our end-customer (30%) for certain seats. Does Redwood support partial split billing for CPPOs?
- Our procurement team also needs the Redwood tax and remittance details (TIN, billing address) + a sample invoice PDF to validate against our AP system.

I attached our MPN file and a draft PO (CloudWave_MPN_and_PO.xlsx) — can you confirm the activation path and whether DocuSign is required for Redwood side?

Alex
Alex Kim
Head of Channel Sales
CloudWave Solutions

Attachment: CloudWave_MPN_and_PO.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Alex Kim <alex@cloudwave.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CPPO: billing flow & split invoicing question

Alex —

Appreciate the clear asks. Short answers up front: yes, we can support split invoicing for CPPO flows with reseller-initiated allocation, and yes, we can provide sample invoice PDFs and tax details.

High-level activation steps (what I'll coordinate):
1) Confirm reseller MPN & PO details (thanks for the sheet) — Marcus will validate eligibility.
2) Legal/pricing sign-off on the CPPO term sheet (I attached Redwood_CPPO_term_sheet_v2.pdf).
3) DocuSign + AWS CPPO creation — typically Redwood signs the term sheet and triggers the CPPO with AWS.
4) Invoice routing config: we'll add billing rules that mark 70% to CloudWave's billing account and 30% to the end-customer account; this requires the end-customer AWS account IDs and CloudWave's AP routing code.

Open items for you: please send the end-customer account IDs for the seats requiring split billing and confirm whether CloudWave will handle tax on behalf of the customer or if each party needs separate tax handling.

I'll loop in Camila from billing to confirm the exact invoice sample format and a checklist of required fields.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Partner Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_CPPO_term_sheet_v2.pdf (term sheet)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Alex Kim <alex@cloudwave.com>, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2027 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CPPO: billing flow & split invoicing question

Alex —

Quick confirmation on eligibility: CloudWave is listed under our reseller programs and qualifies for CPPO discounts at the 250k commit level. A couple of operational notes:

- We will need the explicit list of AWS account IDs for the 30% split to map the usage. Without exact IDs we cannot route charges.
- Pricing: the CPPO unit price in the term sheet assumes a single invoice pass-through; to apply a revenue split we normally attach a separate allocation file during PO ingestion. So please ensure your PO references the allocation percentages (70/30).

Soojin is cc'd for the margin confirmation and to flag if we should apply a special reseller uplift.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Channel Manager, Redwood Inference

From: legal@cloudwave.com
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Kim <alex@cloudwave.com>, priya@cloudwave.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CPPO: billing flow & split invoicing question

Hi Tessa —

Our legal team reviewed the term sheet and has two redlines around liability limits and termination notice. We prefer DocuSign for execution; please confirm whether Redwood's signature block can be updated to include Redwood's S/C address and a representative from the finance team.

Also: for audit purposes CloudWave requires a sample invoice that includes line-item usage, AWS chargeback reference, and Redwood's tax ID. Can you provide that?

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Legal Counsel
CloudWave Solutions

Attachment: none

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2027 11:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CPPO: billing flow & split invoicing question

Tessa / Camila —

I reviewed the pricing and proposed allocation. A couple notes for the billing team:
- We can emit two invoice stubs from Redwood's billing engine that map to the allocation file: one stamped to CloudWave (70%) and one intended for the end-customer (30%) — both will refer to the single underlying CPPO on AWS.
- Tax handling: if CloudWave will collect tax on behalf of the customer we need a signed Tax Agent letter from CloudWave; otherwise tax will be applied per the destination accounts and Redwood will include tax on the CloudWave stub.
- Camila, please prepare a sample invoice (PDF) containing: Redwood tax ID, line-item SKUs & unit prices, AWS marketplace chargeback code, and the allocation reference ID. I'll attach the recommended invoice template in the drive link.

Soojin
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Alex Kim <alex@cloudwave.com>, legal@cloudwave.com
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CPPO: billing flow & split invoicing question

Alex / Priya —

Thanks for the redlines. We can accept the changes with one ask: include a 60-day notice for termination instead of 30, which aligns with our CPPO governance. If that works, we'll update the term sheet and send via DocuSign by EOD Monday.

Next actions (owner / ETA):
- Alex / CloudWave: provide end-customer AWS account IDs + confirm tax handling (by Tue 11/16)
- Priya / CloudWave Legal: confirm acceptance of 60-day termination (by Tue 11/16)
- Camila (Billing): upload sample invoice & fill Tax ID fields into Invoice_Routing_Spec_v1.docx — I'll need that for the DocuSign package (done by Mon 11/15).
- Marcus: I'll trigger CPPO creation with AWS once DocuSign is complete and allocation file is ingested.

I've attached the three working files: Redwood_CPPO_term_sheet_v2.pdf, CloudWave_MPN_and_PO.xlsx (you sent), and Invoice_Routing_Spec_v1.docx (billing checklist).

I'll follow up once DocuSign envelope is generated.

Best,
Tessa
Head of Partner Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_CPPO_term_sheet_v2.pdf (term sheet), CloudWave_MPN_and_PO.xlsx (spreadsheet), Invoice_Routing_Spec_v1.docx (doc)
